title: Change
description: What a later capture of a primary source showed about a row the register had already published: that the source no longer lists it, or lists it again. The published row stays, exactly as published (CHARTER Vow V; INVARIANTS §14); this row shows the change beside it. Written by the adapter (src/adapters/house-fd/build.py, carry_forward) only where the build read the source; a change row never changes and is never removed.

id.description: ch:<change>:<row id>:<the capture's retrieved_at>. One change per row per capture.

row_id.description: The id of the published row the change is about.

rows.description: Which of the register's files holds that row.

change.description: not listed: the capture does not list the row (the Clerk's roster no longer lists the officeholder, the index the filing, the document the transaction). listed again: a later capture lists a row an earlier one did not.

capture.description: The capture that shows the change: the source's URL, when it was retrieved, and the SHA-256 of the bytes.
